cabbage--noun.def: A round vegetable with thick green leaves.

inspire--verb.def: To make someone want to do something good.

positively--adv.def: In a hopeful or approving way.

vague--adj.def: Not clear or exact in meaning.

insight--noun.def: A clear understanding of something complicated.

ripe--adj.def: Fully grown and ready to eat.
ripe--adj.ex: These figs are not ripe yet.

decline--noun.def: A steady fall in amount or quality.
decline--noun.ex: There was a decline in sales.

motto--noun.def: A short sentence that expresses a belief.

moss--noun.def: A soft green plant that grows on damp stones.

notorious--adj.ex: That road is notorious for accidents.

greeting--noun.def: Words or an action used when you meet someone.
greeting--noun.ex: He raised his hand in greeting.

briefly--adv.def: For a short time, or in few words.

slot--noun.def: A narrow opening, or a place in a schedule.
slot--noun.ex: Put the coin in the slot.

keyboard--noun.def: The set of keys used to type on a computer.

cherish--verb.def: To care about something very much.
cherish--verb.exTr: O eski mektupları el üstünde tutuyor.

sponge--noun.def: A soft material full of holes that holds water.
sponge--noun.ex: Wipe the table with a sponge.

calf--noun.def: A young cow, or the back of your lower leg.
calf--noun.ex: The calf stayed near its mother.

allowance--noun.def: Money given regularly for a purpose.

riddle--verb.def: To make many holes in something.
riddle--verb.exTr: Mermiler eski tabelayı delik deşik etti.

publisher--noun.def: A company or person that produces books.

burglar--noun.def: A person who enters a building to steal.
burglar--noun.ex: A burglar broke the back window.

scope--noun.def: The range of things a subject deals with.
scope--noun.ex: That is beyond the scope of this study.

gravy--noun.def: A brown sauce made from meat juices.

devastating--adj.ex: The fire had a devastating effect.

runaway--noun.def: A person who has run away from home.

adapt--verb.def: To change so that you fit a new situation.

isolation--noun.def: The state of being alone or kept apart.

farming--noun.def: The work of growing crops and keeping animals.

determination--noun.def: The quality of continuing despite difficulty.

beaver--noun.def: An animal that cuts trees and builds dams.

moreover--adv.def: In addition to what has been said.
moreover--adv.ex: The plan is costly; moreover it is slow.

bronze--noun.def: A brown metal made of copper and tin.
bronze--noun.ex: The statue is cast in bronze.

airline--noun.def: A company that carries people by plane.

fright--noun.ex: The noise gave me a fright.

contribute--verb.def: To give something to help a shared effort.

disk--noun.def: A flat round object used to store data.

obstacle--noun.def: Something that blocks your way or your progress.

arise--verb.def: To happen or appear, especially a problem.
arise--verb.ex: New questions arose during the test.
arise--verb.exTr: Test sırasında yeni sorular ortaya çıktı.

regain--verb.def: To get something back after losing it.

capsule--noun.def: A small case holding medicine, or part of a spacecraft.

firmly--adv.def: In a strong and steady way.

postcard--noun.def: A card with a picture that you post without an envelope.
postcard--noun.ex: He sent a postcard from Trabzon.

reef--noun.def: A line of rock or coral near the surface of the sea.

mathematics--noun.def: The study of numbers, shapes and measurement.

shameful--adj.def: So bad that it should cause shame.

strategic--adj.def: Part of a plan to achieve a long-term aim.

teller--noun.def: A bank employee who handles money at a counter.

skate--verb.def: To move over ice or ground on special boots.
skate--verb.ex: The children skate on the pond.

pupil--noun.def: A school child, or the dark centre of the eye.
pupil--noun.ex: Each pupil gets a free book.
pupil--noun.exTr: Her öğrenci ücretsiz bir kitap alıyor.

swollen--adj.def: Larger than normal because of injury or water.
swollen--adj.ex: His hand was red and swollen.

liberation--noun.def: The act of setting people or a place free.
liberation--noun.ex: They celebrate the liberation each year.

disturbance--noun.def: Something that interrupts peace or order.

motivation--noun.def: The reason and the desire to do something.

sculpture--noun.def: A work of art made by carving or shaping material.

stressful--adj.def: Causing a lot of worry and pressure.

bathe--verb.def: To wash the body, or to wash a wound gently.
bathe--verb.ex: She bathed the cut in warm water.

stem--verb.def: To come from a source, or to stop a flow.

filter--noun.def: A device that removes unwanted parts from liquid or air.

diaper--noun.def: Cloth or paper worn by a baby, in American English.
diaper--noun.ex: The baby needs a clean diaper.
diaper--noun.exTr: Bebeğin temiz bir beze ihtiyacı var.

increasingly--adv.def: More and more as time passes.

sidewalk--noun.def: The path beside a road, in American English.

initially--adv.def: At the beginning, before things changed.
initially--adv.ex: Initially we planned a short trip.

frequently--adv.ex: Buses run frequently on this line.
frequently--adv.exTr: Bu hatta otobüsler sık sık geçiyor.

nod--noun.def: A movement of the head meaning yes.

philosopher--noun.def: A person who studies deep questions about life.

membership--noun.def: The state of belonging to a group or a club.
membership--noun.ex: Membership costs fifty lira a year.

dolphin--noun.def: An intelligent sea animal that breathes air.

depart--verb.def: To leave, especially to start a journey.
